name: Cuffed Behind the Back Lateral Raise
validation_note: Bands are the standard coaching ranges for this movement, not measured against a labelled clip. Treat a fix verdict as a prompt to look, not as a measured fault.

start_cue.en: Stand tall with the weights at your sides.
start_cue.hi: Seedhe khade ho, weight haath ke bagal mein.

good.en: Good. You raised to full height.

fix.en: Lift higher, up to shoulder height.
fix.hi: Aur upar uthao, kandhe ki height tak.

above.en: Lower slightly if your shoulder pinches.
above.hi: Agar kandhe mein dabav lage toh thoda kam uthao.

below.en: Lift higher, up to shoulder height.
below.hi: Aur upar uthao, kandhe ki height tak.

almost.en: Lift higher, up to shoulder height.
almost.hi: Aur upar uthao, kandhe ki height tak.

fix.en: Too fast. Do not drop the weight. Count 2 seconds.
fix.hi: Bahut tez hai. Weight girao mat. 2 tak gino.

above.en: Very slow. Good control — keep moving smoothly.
above.hi: Bahut slow hai. Control achha hai, smooth chalte raho.

below.en: Too fast. Do not drop the weight. Count 2 seconds.
below.hi: Bahut tez hai. Weight girao mat. 2 tak gino.

almost.en: A bit fast. Count 2 seconds on the way down.
almost.hi: Thoda tez hai. Neeche aate time 2 tak gino.
